name: Glaucous-winged gull
desc: Glaucous-winged Gull (Larus glaucescens): hunts or scavenges other animals. Recorded 678 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The glaucous-winged gull is a large, white-headed gull. The genus name is from Latin Larus which appears to have referred to a gull or other large seabird.
